strengths: All 51 open Draft PRs returned by the GitHub connector were enumerated with exact head SHA, base/head branch, mergeability, phase, and observed CI evidence.
All 85 research/ branches returned by the branch search were classified as active, non-draft active, reserved, superseded, or historical/unclassified.
The active C049.1 route, canonical C039-C044 allocation, C046-C049 allocation, exact top-stack terminal, and C043/C044 review state were read from repository files and PR metadata.
Executable proof artifacts, documentation, proposals, schemas, and workflow paths were aggregated from the complete changed-file lists of the open Draft PR set.
limitations: The repository is a stacked-branch research graph: no single commit contains the entire active state, so this report is an aggregation across PR heads rather than a byte-for-byte tree walk of one ref.

GitHub fetch_file rejects directory paths; directory inventories were reconstructed from all open Draft PR changed-file lists. Files present only on main or on non-open historical branches may be absent from the artifact, proposal, schema, documentation, or workflow arrays.

Blob SHA or content digest was not extracted for every artifact, proposal, schema, and Markdown file; such fields are explicitly marked not extracted. Proposal presence/status is reported instead of an invented digest.
Workflow-run responses exposed run IDs, run numbers, status, and conclusion but not completion timestamps; completion times are explicitly marked not found.
PR #22 had no exact-head workflow runs returned by the connector; its body references successful run 30759544324, recorded only as PR-body evidence.
PR #35 and PR #36 each had a successful specialized workflow but a failing JANUS registry workflow at the audited head.
PR #47 and PR #57 are Draft and CI-green but non-mergeable; PR #22 is also non-mergeable and lacks exact-head CI evidence.
integrity_note.non_fabrication_statement: Every unavailable datum is marked absent, not found, not extracted, branch-dependent, or unclassified; no missing SHA, digest, timestamp, workflow result, or freeze state was inferred as fact.
